text:
Type: tall two-door glass display cabinet
Use: displaying and storing books, glassware or tableware; living room, dining room, home office
Style: classic, contemporary, mid-century modern
Materials: dark stained wood veneer, clear glass doors, wooden adjustable shelves
Colors: dark brown, warm taupe interior
Shape: tall rectangular cabinet with two framed glass doors, long vertical bar handles at the center, five shelves, slim tapered legs, tall and stately
Feel: refined, warm, stately, calm
Goes with: dark wood, leather, cream walls, brass accents; classic or contemporary dining rooms, libraries and studies
